description: Remove a Tango task (reversible soft delete): the task and its subtasks are hidden from every list, link, report and agent queue, and their URLs return 404. Platform staff can restore them. This is NOT the same as setting status to 'archived', which keeps the task visible. Only organization owners/admins can remove a task.

confirm.description: Must be true to acknowledge this hides the task from everyone.

reason.description: Short note explaining why the task is being removed.

task_id.description: Task id, or a pasted Tango task URL.

name: delete_task
title: Remove a task
